memory_notes: peak_ram_mb: sum over the listed processes of the kernel high-water ri_interval_max_phys_footprint (proc_pid_rusage RUSAGE_INFO_V4, interval reset at case start); per-process peaks may occur at different moments, so the sum is an upper bound of the simultaneous peak.

peak_vram_mb: Apple Silicon has unified memory (no separate VRAM). Value = max over 5 Hz + turn-boundary samples of IOAccelerator 'In use system memory' minus the idle baseline taken before llama-server started. System-wide scope; it overlaps peak_ram_mb, never add the two.
rss_mb: sum of per-process peak RSS; it includes mmapped model weights and overcounts on unified memory, reported only for comparison.
mb = MiB (2^20 bytes).
